title: EcosystemRecord
description: A normalized record for a blockchain ecosystem or social layer. Encodes the AI-readiness, tooling philosophy, and current state of the ecosystem as a reasoning context.

type.description: Architectural classification. L2 chains are differentiated from L1 because tooling assumptions differ (bridging, fee structure, deployment constraints).

skill_install.description: Primary command to install the official ecosystem skill pack.

docs_ai_access.description: AI-specific documentation access points. Populated only with confirmed endpoints — do not guess.

llms_txt.description: URL of llms.txt if ecosystem has implemented the standard.

mcp_server.description: MCP server URL if live endpoint exists.

resources_for_agents.description: Dedicated documentation page for AI agents (not human developers).

community_skill_count.description: Number of community-maintained skills available. Rough estimate is acceptable.

community_hub.description: Primary community skill aggregation point. e.g. 'sendaifun/skills' for Solana.

dominant_workflows.description: WorkflowRecord IDs that represent the primary use cases in this ecosystem.

sdk_migration.description: Active SDK migration state. Critical for freshness — skills referencing deprecated SDKs are wrong.

philosophy.description: One-sentence description of the ecosystem's operational philosophy. Used in cross-ecosystem recommendation reasoning.

agent_assumptions.description: How this ecosystem assumes AI agents will interact with it. e.g. 'Agents interface directly with protocols — no abstraction layer assumed.'

orchestration_maturity.description: How mature the orchestration tooling is in this ecosystem. Informs whether multi-step agent workflows are production-ready.

security_maturity.description: How mature the security tooling and culture is.
